name: KytyPS5
notes: KytyPS5 is an experimental PlayStation 5 emulator. It boots 2D games and a selection of 3D games (Unreal Engine 4/5, Unity, custom engines); most titles do not work yet and compatibility changes from one daily build to the next. See https://kytyps5.github.io/ for community test results.
Requires a GPU and driver with Vulkan 1.3.

OmniDeck launches kyty_emulator.exe directly (no launcher window, no update check). KytyPS5 has no settings file of its own: OmniDeck passes every option on the command line and keeps them in omnideck-kyty.json.
KytyPS5 stores saves, trophies and download data relative to its working directory; OmniDeck starts it inside the OmniDeck Saves folder for KytyPS5 so saves never live in the program folder.

Controllers are read through SDL3 with a fixed DualSense layout (South=Cross, East=Circle, West=Square, North=Triangle). KytyPS5 has no gamepad remapping, dead-zone or controller hotkeys, so OmniDeck can only apply rumble on/off. F11 or Alt+Enter toggles fullscreen; close the window to exit.
No PlayStation firmware or system modules are required. PlayStation 4 games are not supported by KytyPS5.
assumptions: Release packaging (.github/workflows/build.yml, job 'release'): tag KytyPS5-<UTC date>-<7-char sha>; Windows asset <tag>-Windows-x64.zip zipped from the cmake install prefix, so launcher.exe, kyty_emulator.exe, kyty_updater.exe and libwinpthread-1.dll sit at the archive root (CMakeLists.txt install(TARGETS kyty_emulator DESTINATION .), src/launcher/CMakeLists.txt). Releases are created with 'gh release create' without --prerelease, so they are full releases and /releases/latest returns them (also confirmed on the releases page: KytyPS5-2026-10-10-307fdcf is 'Latest').
Several releases are published per day (e.g. four on 2026-10-10); the tag date alone cannot order them (upstream src/launcher/src/updateChecker.cpp compares published_at for this reason).

kyty_emulator CLI (src/main.cpp PrintUsage/ParseArgs): --game <dir|elf|zar> (a directory loads /app0/eboot.bin), --screen-width/--screen-height (video-out resolution reported to the game, src/libs/agc.cpp Initialize -> VideoOutInit), --fullscreen, --present-mode Fifo|Mailbox|Immediate, --gpu <index>, --controller-vibration 0-100, --printf-direction Silent|Console|File, --printf-output-file <path>, --keymap Control=Key, --game-patch <json>, --help (prints usage and exits 0 without opening a window).

There is no emulator config file: Config::ConfigOptions (src/common/emulatorConfig.h) is filled only from the command line. The Qt launcher stores its own settings in Kyty.ini (QSettings IniFormat) in the working directory if that file exists, otherwise in the system scope (src/launcher/src/configurationListWidget.cpp ReadSettings/WriteSettings).
The main log goes to --printf-output-file when --printf-direction File is given (src/common/logging/log.cpp Initialize uses Config::GetPrintfOutputFile); the default direction is Silent.

Save data lives in ./_SaveData/<TITLE_ID> relative to the working directory (src/libs/libSaveData.cpp SAVE_DATA_DIR, marked 'TODO specify dir at launcher'); trophies in ./_Trophies (src/common/trophies.cpp UnlocksPath with an empty root); /download0 and /temp0 are mounted from ./_DownloadData/<TITLE_ID> and ./_TempData/<TITLE_ID> (src/emulator.cpp MountSandboxDirs); the Vulkan pipeline cache is ./_PipelineCache/<TITLE_ID>.bin (pipelineCache.cpp); ./_Textures is cleared on every start (emulator.cpp ClearDebugTextureFolder).

The Qt launcher runs kyty_emulator with the working directory set to the emulator folder (src/launcher/src/mainDialog.cpp RunInterpreter setWorkingDirectory), so games started from the launcher UI keep their saves in the program folder; those folders are listed in persistentAppPaths. Cheat plans live in <app>/_Patches/<PPSA id>.json (src/launcher/src/cheatFile.cpp PlanPath).

The updater only runs from the launcher: MainDialog checks [MainDialog] check_updates_on_startup (default true) after start (src/launcher/src/mainDialog.cpp FindInterpreter/ReadSettings). kyty_emulator itself has no update check and shows no modal dialogs (no MessageBox calls outside src/launcher).

Gamepads: SDL3 gamepad API with a fixed button map (src/graphics/presentation/window/window.cpp ControllerButtonToPadButton); --keymap only remaps keyboard/mouse (hostInput.cpp InputMap) and reserves Escape, F1, F7, F11. F11 and Alt+Enter toggle desktop fullscreen (window.cpp GameEventKeyboard).
Only sce_sys/param.json (PS5 format) is parsed (src/loader/systemContent.cpp Psf::OpenJson); there is no param.sfo/PS4 loader, so PS4 games are not supported.

Vulkan 1.3 is required (shaders built with --target-env vulkan1.3; vulkanWindow.cpp rejects devices below VULKAN_TARGET_API_VERSION). README: 'External low-level emulation modules are neither required nor planned.'
The Windows build uses clang-cl with the dynamic MSVC runtime and windeployqt --no-compiler-runtime, so the Visual C++ x64 redistributable is needed.

The executable has no Windows version resource; --help prints 'ver = 0.3.0, git = <git describe>' where git describe in CI is the short commit hash (the release tag is created after the build), so the installed version comes from the release tag OmniDeck installed.

Several dated builds can be published per day (tags KytyPS5-YYYY-MM-DD-<hash>), so OmniDeck versions are derived from the release publish time plus the commit hash (download.versionFrom = published-at) to order same-day builds correctly.
